newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino sets venture for Tai Kok Tsui plan.
newsitem.headline: Sino sets venture for Tai Kok Tsui plan.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd, Kerry Properties Ltd, Bank of China Group Investment Ltd, and China Overseas Land & Investment Ltd said they have formed a venture company Benefit Bright B.V.I. to develop Hong Kong's Tai Kok Tsui railway station.
The venture will be 42.5 percent owned by Sino Land, 32.5 percent by Kerry, 15 percent by Bank of China Group and 10 percent by China Overseas Land, the companies said in separate statements.

Benefit Bright will engage in the second package development of Hong Kong's Tai Kok Tsui railway station which awarded by Hong Kong's Mass Transit Railway Corp (MTRC) earlier in August. The development cost is estimated at HK$15 billion.
